entries.subject: Archive access and query interface
entries.finding: The SMA archive offers a public web search and download of data older than the proprietary period, with no login; a separate archive holds proprietary data. No TAP endpoint was found.
entries.revisitWhen: A body in this repository needs submillimetre interferometry.

entries.subject: Proprietary period, licence and credit
entries.finding: Regular projects carry a 15-month proprietary period and large-scale projects 12 months after the last observation. No reuse licence is published; the Smithsonian and Academia Sinica joint-project sentence is the stated credit.
entries.revisitWhen: This facility's data are used, or its terms are needed for a derived product.

entries.subject: Reduction software
entries.finding: MIR reduces SMA data but is IDL-based and needs a commercial IDL licence, and its repository declares no open-source licence; the observatory recommends MIRIAD or CASA for imaging.
entries.revisitWhen: Raw data from this facility are reduced here.
